skills.title: AI Skills
skills.intro: The agent skills I use every day in my agentic development workflow.

items.name: grill-me
items.desc: The agent interviews me relentlessly about a plan or design until every weak spot is out in the open.

items.name: improve-codebase-architecture
items.desc: Scans a codebase for deepening opportunities, shows them as a visual report, then grills me through the one I pick.

items.name: caveman
items.desc: Makes the agent talk like a caveman: answer first, fluff gone, every technical fact kept. Fewer tokens, faster reading.

items.name: caveman-review
items.desc: Code review in one line per finding: where it is, what’s wrong, how to fix it.

items.name: caveman-commit
items.desc: Writes a Conventional Commits message cut down to the intent. I use it after every feature.

items.name: impeccable
items.desc: One skill to design, critique, audit and polish any interface: hierarchy, type, color, motion, accessibility.

items.name: frontend-design
items.desc: Pushes the agent past generic AI-looking UI toward bold, intentional design choices.

items.name: agent-skills
items.desc: Senior-engineer workflows and quality gates for the whole software lifecycle, for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more.

items.name: reverse-engineer-anything
items.desc: Reverse engineers apps, binaries and websites without their source, explains how a feature works with evidence, then helps build it.

items.name: graphify
items.desc: Maps a whole project (code, docs, PDFs, images) into a knowledge graph the agent can query instead of grepping through files.
items.cmd: uv tool install graphifyy && graphify install

items.name: claude-code-setup
items.desc: Scans a codebase and recommends tailored Claude Code automations: hooks, skills, MCP servers, subagents and slash commands.

bookmarks.intro: Courses, tools and sites worth your time, plus the browser extensions I can’t live without.

feature.title: Introduction to LangGraph
feature.desc: The official free course on LangGraph: state, memory, human-in-the-loop and multi-agent systems, from the team that builds it.

items.desc: Step-by-step roadmaps for every developer role and skill.

items.desc: Write backprop, a tokenizer, attention and an agent loop by hand before touching a framework.

items.title: Introduction to MCP

items.title: AI Agents in LangGraph
items.desc: A short DeepLearning.AI course that builds an agent from scratch, then rebuilds it with LangGraph.

items.title: Hugging Face MCP Course
items.desc: Free course on the Model Context Protocol, from the concepts to working servers.

items.title: Prompt Engineering Guide
items.desc: Techniques, papers and examples for prompting LLMs and building with them.

items.title: System Design Primer

sections.title: AI tools
sections.desc: Gateways, observability and storage for LLM apps.

items.title: OmniRoute
items.desc: Free, open-source AI gateway: one OpenAI-compatible endpoint across hundreds of providers, with automatic fallback.

items.title: Headroom
items.desc: Compresses what an AI agent reads (tool output, logs, files, history) before it reaches the model. Runs locally as a library, proxy or MCP server.

items.title: Langfuse
items.desc: Open-source LLM observability: traces, evals, prompt management and costs.

items.title: OpenRouter
items.desc: One API and key for hundreds of LLMs, with price comparison and fallbacks.

items.title: pgvector
items.desc: Vector similarity search inside PostgreSQL, for RAG and embeddings.
